0.text: A hooded figure steps out of the shadows and blocks your path, studying you with calm eyes.

choices.text: I have no time for this.

0-0.speaker: Stranger
0-0.text: The stranger holds your gaze for a moment, then steps aside without a word.

0-1.speaker: Stranger
0-1.text: A scout. I've been watching this floor for three days. There are things down here you haven't seen yet.

0-1-0.speaker: Stranger
0-1-0.text: Pressure plate, third corridor east. Whoever built this place didn't want company. Watch your step.

0-1-1.text: The stranger shrugs and slips back into the shadows.

0-2.text: The stranger nods once and steps aside, vanishing into the dark as if they were never there.
